title: List Comprehensions ([Expr || Generator, Filter]), Pattern Filtering & Joins
solutionExplanation: Implements declarative list comprehensions with pattern-matching generators and multi-generator relational joins.

otpDocCards.description: Syntactic sugar for map and filter combinations with automatic pattern-matching filtering and nested generator looping.
otpDocCards.complexityNote: Compiled by BEAM into optimized tail-recursive accumulator loops.

mentalModelCheck.question: What happens in [Name || {user, Id, Name, active} <- Users] if Users contains {user, 2, "Bob", suspended}?

options.label: The element is silently skipped by the generator pattern match without raising any exceptions
options.explanation: Comprehension generators silently discard elements that fail the left-hand pattern match.

options.label: The BEAM VM raises a function_clause or badmatch exception
options.explanation: Generators filter out non-matching elements rather than crashing.

options.label: Bob is emitted as undefined in the output list
options.explanation: Non-matching elements are completely omitted from the resulting list.
